body:
Some history on me to start. Drugs I've done include weed, benadryl, all kinds of psychedelics, (meth)amphetamines, benzos, opiates (heroin), GHB and my DOCs: DXM, MXE, MXM, and Ketamine.
For about a 7 month period that started a little over a year ago, I used MXE every night culminating in IM and plugged doses reaching over 600mg. I stopped because my tolerance hit a wall and the magic had gone, so I moved back to other drugs. My tolerance is still fairly high, though I can hole now off of 150mg IM'd.
INTRO
2-Methylamino-2-phenylcyclohexanone is a completely new RC that I had the good fortune of being one of the first to test it. AFAIK, this is the only trip/experience report currently published for this chemical.
It was sold to me as 'New' Ket, but seeing as it's bad to name a chemical as being the new or alternative version to another one, the consensus seemed to be that Deschloroketamine would be what we would call it. I'll refer to it as that from now on.
It's advertised as a Ketamine replacement. It's much cheaper, I found it to be (as advertised) about 2x more potent than K, and lasting about twice as long.
EXPERIENCE REPORT
After conducting an allergy test at around 8pm, and not noticing anything out of the ordinary after an hour, I decided to get going on prepping some syringes for IM injection.
The deschloroketamine came in crystal clear shards, just like K should look. I was able to dissolve two 1ml shots of 63mg and 128 mg respectively. The crystals dissolved instantly - no heat and almost no stirring required.
I got my ice pack ready, which I like to use with a blindfold- set up my play list, and laid on my back on my bed.
My 2x 1ml 1 1/2' 29 gauge syringes were ready for use (along with my alcohol prep pads and band-aids)
11:50pm: First injection of 63mg into left thigh
- T+0:10 -Felt trademark dissociation. Motor skills were slighly impaired and there was a
delay between my thoughts and actions.
- T+0:15 -Music sounds great on this chemical and seems to shape the hole a lot.
- T+0:20 - Felt somewhere in between K and MXE at this point. Smooth and sedating like K, but warm like MXE.
- T+0:25 - IM'd the second dose of 128mg.
- T+0:35 -Wow, evthjsfd
- T-1:20 Peaking. I slid around looking at all these giant ice pods late belonged to the Old Gods. The images were pretty detailed, and the colors were very industrial and blur.
My writing became totally illegible and I think I forgot about the paper entirely.
NOTES:
I made the mistake of taking this unkown substance while on two antidepressants, Mirtazapine and Cymbalta; I believe Deschloroketamine to be very serotonergic, hence the warm euphoria and the lingering discomfort I felt after my experience. Stay away from other serotonin reuptake inhibitors.
I'm excited for this to be more widely available within the next year. Deschloroketamine is smooth and engrossing like K, but controllable and warm like MXE; it is a great, cheap, K alternative, while still being a terrific chemical on its own.
